opening.argument: The material promotes unusually high-value Sephora rewards through free-gift-card and product claims, including a $500 gift card and wording inviting viewers to imagine a $1000 gift card. The title uses limited-time language, while the frame states, "Claim your Free $500 Sephora® Gift Card now!" and the description directs viewers to click an external destination to obtain it. Participation is further tied to signing up for $500 worth of Sephora products. These features present a low-barrier opportunity to acquire substantial value while leaving unresolved who operates the destination, whether Sephora authorized the offer, what information sign-up requests, and whether any reward is delivered. The records therefore support the asserted concern without establishing losses, authorization, or a delivered outcome.
